findings.quote: who were sailing in Taurion’s ships and had anchored alongside them as friends with four vessels
findings.problem: Greek: Ἀγαθίνῳ δὲ καὶ Κασσάνδρῳ τοῖς Κορινθίοις ἐπιπλέουσι ταῖς Ταυρίωνος ναυσὶ ... μετὰ τεττάρων πλοίων. The Corinthians have their own four vessels (μετὰ τεττάρων πλοίων); ἐπιπλέουσι + dative means sailing up to / to join Taurion's ships, not sailing in them.
findings.proposed_fix: who were sailing to join Taurion’s ships and had anchored alongside them as friends with four vessels

units.note: Greek ends mid-sentence (τῆς / πράξεως continues in ch. 98); English completes it acceptably.
